description: This file defines the AttendanceRecordDecorator class, which provides methods to wrap an AttendanceRecord object with additional presentation logic and timezone conversions related to employee attendance records within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: AttendanceRecordDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class for AttendanceRecord entity, adding methods for timezone conversion, formatted date/time retrieval, and presentation logic related to employee punch times.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with an AttendanceRecord object.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee associated with the attendance record using an employee number.

methods.name: getAttendanceState
methods.description: Returns the attendance state in a human-readable format.

methods.name: getPunchInUTCDate
methods.description: Returns the punch-in UTC date as a formatted string.

methods.name: getPunchInUTCTime
methods.description: Returns the punch-in UTC time as a formatted string.

methods.name: getPunchInUserDate
methods.description: Returns the punch-in user timezone date as a formatted string.

methods.name: getPunchInUserTime
methods.description: Returns the punch-in user timezone time as a formatted string.

methods.name: getPunchOutUTCDate
methods.description: Returns the punch-out UTC date as a formatted string.

methods.name: getPunchOutUTCtime
methods.description: Returns the punch-out UTC time as a formatted string.

methods.name: getPunchOutUserDate
methods.description: Returns the punch-out user timezone date as a formatted string.

methods.name: getPunchOutUserTime
methods.description: Returns the punch-out user timezone time as a formatted string.

methods.name: getPunchInUserDateTime
methods.description: Returns the punch-in in user timezone as a DateTime object.

methods.name: getPunchInUTCDateTime
methods.description: Returns the punch-in in UTC as a DateTime object.

methods.name: getPunchOutUserDateTime
methods.description: Returns the punch-out in user timezone as a DateTime object.

methods.name: getPunchOutUTCDateTime
methods.description: Returns the punch-out in UTC as a DateTime object.

methods.name: getPunchInTimezoneLabel
methods.description: Provides a label indicating the timezone for punch-in times.

methods.name: getPunchOutTimezoneLabel
methods.description: Provides a label indicating the timezone for punch-out times.
